<p class="MsoNormal" style="">The nursery use shall not commence until a plan indicating
the positions, design, materials and type of boundary treatments to be erected within
the car park, pick up/drop off area, playground have been submitted to, and
approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The boundary treatment
shall be completed before the nursery use hereby permitted is commenced. The uses
shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter
be retained.<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style=""><span style="background-image: initial; background-position: initial; background-size: initial; background-repeat: initial; background-attachment: initial; background-origin: initial; background-clip: initial;">The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the
expiration of three years from the date of this permission.<o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>The
Nursery use hereby permitted shall not be open to customers outside the
following times: 07:30-18:30 (Mon-Fri) only, without the prior written
permission of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>The
premises shall be used for the purpose specified on the application and for no
other purpose, including any other purpose in Class. F1(f) or E(f) of the
Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (or in any
provision equivalent to that Class in any Statutory Instrument revoking and
re-enacting that order with or without modification).</p>

<p>The
cycle storage details as detailed on drawing references P 01 and P 09 shall be implemented
in full, retained as such and made available for use prior to first occupation
of the site for the approved nursery use.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Prior to the first use of the site as a Nursery, a Car Park
Management Plan (CPMP) shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
local planning authority. The management plan shall outline measures to ensure
that the car park on site, along with all associated vehicles using the car
park, do not result in adverse impacts upon the public highway. The CPMP should
contain the following forms of mitigation;&nbsp;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">- Details of signage within the site advising
existing vehicles to give priority to those entering.</p><p class="MsoNormal" style="">- Details of marshalling by the users of the site
at peak times of development operation, including but not limited to numbers of
staff and details of marshalling times.</p>

<p class="MsoNormal" style="">Prior to the first use of the Nursery hereby permitted, a
full Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the
local planning authority. The development shall be carried out and operated in
accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="">Prior
to the first use of the site as a mixed use Nursery and Place of Worship, a
Travel Plan, covering each use separately, shall be submitted to and approved
in writing by the local planning authority and shall thereafter be implemented.
Thereafter, an annually updated Travel Plan shall be submitted for review to
and approved in writing by the local planning authority for a period of 5 years
from the commencement of use. Once approved, each Travel Plan shall be
implemented in full.<i><font face="Arial, sans-serif"><o:p></o:p></font></i></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">

description: Change of use from Place of Worship (F1) to a mixed use of Place of worship (F1) and Nursery (E)
